scope: Complete journeys captured at normal speed; complete encoded videos played at 1x to ended with media errors checked. Agent visual review uses captured scene checkpoints and decoded frames, rather than human novice testing.
findings: Opening establishes resources; next-action copy follows each relationship; interest is grouped below the house on mobile; same-principal pricing and direct smaller-deposit switch are explicit; final totals share one scale and clearly name the conditional result. Removed redundant Home label after a failing frame-by-frame transition test; replacement recordings use the correction. Short-screen secondary controls are reachable by scrolling above the fixed navigation.
